messages:
lena: Heads up — the curl example in runtime quickstart is returning 404 in staging. When I follow the example it tries to download `/assets/examples/onboard.sh` and gets a 404. Link in doc: https://docs.internal/runtime/quickstart#curl

docs-bot: Automated link scan found 1 broken asset: `/assets/examples/onboard.sh` (status 404). Reported at 2024-04-25T14:10:00Z.

max: I can take a look — last week we reorganized example scripts into `/examples/` and added versioned filenames. Probable move to `/examples/onboard-v2.sh`.

lena: awesome, thanks. I opened a quick branch to patch the markdown (sed replace) and wired a tiny test in staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4873 (WIP). Needs reviewer + CI.

ashley: Quick note — runtime guide ownership lives with eng-docs but i'm happy to review small link fixes. @maria is the localization owner for ja/ko, fyi.

max: here's the one-liner I used locally to update the file:```bash
sed -i 's@/assets/examples/onboard.sh@/examples/onboard-v2.sh@g' docs/runtime/quickstart.md
# also update the curl example to point to the new anchor `#quickstart-curl` instead of `#curl`
```

ashley: nice. Small nit: the anchor changed when we restructured the headings, so update both the path and the anchor or the link will still 404 on the example jump.

max: updated PR with both changes (path + anchor), pushed force. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4873/files

ci-bot: PR 4873 — CI passed (unit/link-checker), staging deploy starting.

lena: verified in staging after deploy — curl example now downloads `/examples/onboard-v2.sh` and the jump-to-curl anchor works. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ashley: can we backport to ja/ko docs? The automated i18n snapshot will still reference old path. @maria can you queue a localization backport or we can open a follow-up PR if easier.

maria: i'll add a changelist to the i18n queue and ping the translators. If anyone sees other examples moved in runtime, drop them here and i'll add to the same job to avoid churn.

max: noted — i'll run a grep across runtime/ to catch any leftover `/assets/examples/onboard.sh` refs and open follow-ups as needed.

lena: thanks folks — closing my staging check ticket. If anything else pops up i'll reopen.
